Rubber practice (report and video presentation) (Block 2: Elasto-plasticity and Fracture)

Partial test (Block 3: Electrical, Magnetic, and Optical Properties)

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, the final grade is the sum of three blocks, each contributing approximately 1/3. To sum the blocks, a minimum average of 4/10 (3/7.5) in the written exams is required. If this threshold is not met, the subject is failed. For the extraordinary call, evaluation is similar, but blocks and sections passed in the first call are retained. If exercise submissions, participation, or practice were failed in the first call, they will not be considered, and the final grade will be based solely on the written exam.
